title: Malaria outbreak in Balaghat, death toll rise to 28+
ground_truth: A severe malaria outbreak is occurring in the Balaghat district of Madhya Pradesh, India, with the death toll rising to over 28, heavily affecting the local Adivasi (indigenous) community.
official_record: The report features an embedded video feed (ID: NF6rgn6Ln3g) compiled from grassroots sources via FetchRSS, indicating a critical public health crisis with rising casualties in the region.
context_gap: The reporting lacks detailed official statistics on the exact breakdown of cases, the specific malaria strain causing the outbreak, the status of local medical infrastructure, and the government's targeted intervention efforts to contain the spread among the vulnerable Adivasi population.
